title: Savings Plans Purchase Analyzer
summary: Added a new feature to help you estimate the cost, coverage, and utilization impact of the Savings Plans you plan to purchase.
quote: | [Savings Plans Purchase Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-analyzer.html) | Added a new feature to help you estimate the cost, coverage, and utilization impact of the Savings Plans you plan to purchase. | November 21, 2024 |

title: Return Savings Plans
summary: Added a new feature to return any Savings Plan with an hourly commitment of $100 or less, purchased in the last seven days and in the same calendar month.
quote: | [Return Savings Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-purchase.html#return-sp) | Added a new feature to return any Savings Plan with an hourly commitment of $100 or less, purchased in the last seven days and in the same calendar month. | March 20, 2024 |
